info.title: api-blueprint
info.description: Backend for Frontend for Blueprint and RBAC

tags.name: Role Assignments
tags.description: Role Assignments are roles assigned to a user. They have clauses which define permissions on scopes.

tags.name: Permission Assignments
tags.description: Assigning a role to a user ultimately results in granting them permissions.

tags.name: Directory Locks
tags.description: Locks must be mapped to directory items so that access permissions can apply to them.

tags.name: Access Paths
tags.description: Access to inner spaces depends on access to one or more outer spaces, such as entrances or lobbies.

tags.name: Scopes
tags.description: Scopes are directory items where the user has some permissions, which also cascade below.

tags.name: Internal
tags.description: Internal API non intended for public use

tags.name: Lock Debugging
tags.description: DEBUG endpoints for locks. For internal use only!

tags.name: Permission Sets
tags.description: Permissions are very granular. Permission sets group them together, improving role maintainability.

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: Roles are collections of clause templates. They can be assigned to users to grant them permissions.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Users are the subjects of RBAC; roles are assigned to them, granting them permissions.
